---
title: "set_title"
author: "Tom Naber"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"

knit: 
  (function(inputFile, encoding) { 
    source(here::here('scripts', 'helpers', 'rmd_param_knitter.R'));
  
    filename_constructor <- function(params, inputFile) {
      parts <- c(
        inputFile
      );
      
      here::here("output", "html", paste(parts, collapse = "_"));
    };
  
    smart_knitter(inputFile, out_path = filename_constructor, auto_close = FALSE);
  })
    
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    df_ppi_print: paged
    highlight: tango
    self_contained: true
    fig_width: 6.4
    fig_height: 4.8
    code_folding: hide
    
editor_options:
  markdown:
    wrap: 100
  chunk_output_type: inline
  
params:
  save_figures:
    label: "Save figures"
    value: FALSE
    input: checkbox
---

# Set-up

## Set options & import sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6.4,
  fig.height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600,
  fig.retina = 1,
  out.width = "100%",
  out.height = "100%",
  dev = "ragg_png",
  error = FALSE
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = here::here()
)

options(
  contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"),
  knitr.duplicate.label = "allow",
  future.globals.maxSize = 650*1024^2
)

library(ragg)
library(here)
library(sameplot)
```
